content.comment_body: Hello, I have managed to send emails with digital alerts from the [product_name]. My question is: Is there a way to send counter data or analog input values in the emails that the [product_name] sends?

Hello [user_name], Please use English in this forum. Thank you. To answer your question: No, currently you cannot include variables in an email. Perhaps this feature will be available in future versions of the [product_name].

analysis.insight_summary: The user is able to send digital alert emails using the [product_name], but cannot include analog or counter variable data in these messages. This restricts the type of information that can be sent via email alerts.
analysis.user_expectations: The user would like the [product_name] to support sending emails that can include analog or counter variables along with digital alerts.
pain_keywords: cannot send variable data via email
